label: Availability
description: How many of the unit a side may field at once. Count only a cap the game puts on this unit itself; a population or army cap shared by all units does not count.

terms.label: Open
terms.description: No cap of its own: held back only by price, tech, the population cap or respawn rules.

terms.label: Limited
terms.description: The game caps this unit at a few at a time per player or side: a unit cap, a slot limit or a set number of spawns on the map.

terms.label: Unique
terms.description: A one-of-a-kind character the game allows once per player or side: a named hero, a commando or the army's commander unit. This is the hero flag (decision 7B). An ordinary vehicle capped at one, by a unit cap or by map spawns, is limited.
